CREATE FUNCTION CDN.SubstringEx(@str varchar(255),@sep varchar(255),@ix int) RETURNS VARCHAR(255) AS BEGIN DECLARE @tempstr varchar(255) DECLARE @counter int DECLARE @pos int
If @ix < 1 Return ''
Set @counter = 1 Set @tempstr = @str
Set @pos=charindex(@sep,@tempstr,1)
While @pos>0 Begin if @counter = @ix Begin set @tempstr = substring(@tempstr,1,@pos-1) break End
set @tempstr = substring(@tempstr,@pos+1,len(@tempstr))
set @pos=charindex(@sep,@tempstr,1)
If @pos > 0 set @counter = @counter + 1 End
If @counter < @ix -1 Return ''
Return @tempstr END
